correctness.rationale: Every permutahedral vertex has centered squared norm n(n²−1)/12. Independent Rademacher edge-root signs for Para yield (n−1)³/2. For Loday tree vertices x_i=left_leaf_count×right_leaf_count, the additive squared-coordinate toll has Catalan GF S(z)=2z C(z) S(z)+z A(z)², A(z)=(1−2z)/(1−4z)^{3/2}; coefficient gives average coordinate square n(n+1)(n²+7n+7)/30. Subtracting n(n+1)²/4 using the known common vertex barycenter yields Asso inertia n(n−1)(n+1)(2n+1)/60. Differences factor as n(n−2)(n−1)(n+1)/30 and −(n−2)(n−1)(2n²−23n+15)/60, giving equality at n2 and sharp flip at integer n11. Fresh independent exact rational recursion checked tree toll through n30 and all inertias/order through n50, including n10 Asso=693/2 Para=729/2 and n11 Asso=506 Para=500; proof is symbolic all n.
residual_risks: The equal-coordinate vertex barycenter for all three nested polytopes is a cited primary premise; it is not being reproved solely by finite Catalan data. Uniform vertex sampling differs fundamentally from volume sampling.
